exposure: computerized cardiotocography (cCTG) parameters (Fetal Heart Rate, Delta, Short Term Variability, Long Term Variability, Acceleration Phase Rectified Slope, Deceleration Phase Rectified Slope, Low Term Index, Interval Index, Approximate Entropy, Low Frequency, High Frequency)
outcome: neonatal outcomes (birth weight, Apgar index at 1 and 5 min, pH, pCO2, pO2, base excess, lactates)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies affected by intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), both uncomplicated (controls) and complicated by preeclampsia (cases).
finding: Computerized cardiotocography (cCTG) parameters were significantly associated with preeclampsia complications in IUGR pregnancies, certain placental vascular alterations, and various neonatal outcomes including birth weight and Apgar scores.
